Description: PLV functional connectivity for ballpass task: Observe right→left then imagine left→right
ComputationDetails: Calculated from preprocessed EEG; Frequency bands: theta (4-7Hz), alpha (8-12Hz), beta (13-29Hz), gamma (30-48Hz); Time windows: 20 consecutive 100ms windows (1-100ms to 1901-2000ms); 40 ROIs; PLV file order matches preprocessing subject order
